notes.title: Demons Never Lie New Look!
notes.content:
Demons Never Lie has now a completely new look! A better cover image that describes better the soul of the game. What do you think? Do you like it? Your feedback is always welcome.

[i][b]Before:[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35792989/3b199617377fd082d26eacd3a7ab1cfdbe817bbb.png[/img]
[i][b]After:[/b][/i]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35792989/16e28f0d6e4379ba0a6dc88c38cb2e81bdbc3962.png[/img]

Ocaso will now be the main character on the cover of the game, creating a more mysterious, dark and challenging atmosphere.
Will you dare to make a pact with him? Will you sell your soul to have the life you've always dreamed of?
There's only one way to find out and that's by playing Demons Never Lie... if you haven't already!

[b]#StayHome special discount (-40%)[/b]

Most of you are probably in quarantine during these unprecedented times. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35792989/004dbb3f4db7dd4d0a3dd4a1e76f94a00dcfbf08.png[/img]

As a support to all those people who, like me, have to stay at home, Demons Never Lie will have a new 40% discount during this week. Stay home and stay safe!

Also all the bugs that have been reported during tha last weeks have been fixed in the last update.
So... what are you waiting for? Play it now and discover one of the most emotionally impactful games you have ever played!

notes.title: Demons Never Lie Demo now available on Mac & Linux too
notes.content:
Demons Never Lie Demo now available on Windows, Mac & Linux so everybody can enjoy this creepy/dark graphic adventure at home!

This demo last around 30 minutes and remember is also available in 5 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese.

Play as John, help him to fix his life, avoiding terrible past mistakes... with a demon on your side.
